name: ricky
description: Work with your Ricky inbox and CRM: contacts, conversations, reports and business knowledge.

interface.longDescription: Ricky is the shared inbox and CRM where businesses answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Find contacts and their notes, read conversations, tag and update contacts, and see conversation and response-time reports for the Ricky organization you connect. Actions that change data or message a customer ask for your confirmation first.
defaultPrompt: Which of my contacts need a follow-up?
Show me Maria Gonzalez's details and notes.
How many conversations did we get this week?

positive.description: Find a contact and read their record
positive.prompt: Show me Maria Gonzalez's details and notes in Ricky.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Maria Gonzalez from Blue Door Bakery with her email, phone, stage, the VIP and Wholesale tags, and her notes, including the Tuesday delivery note.

positive.prompt: Which of my Ricky contacts are tagged Follow-up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists exactly Sofia Ramirez, Daniel Kim and Robert Silva, with the reason each needs a follow-up taken from their notes.

positive.prompt: Add a note to James Carter in Ricky: sent the office subscription quote today.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds James Carter, asks the user to confirm the note, adds it after confirmation, and reports that the note was saved without removing earlier notes.

positive.prompt: What are Harbor Coffee's opening hours on Saturday, according to Ricky?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. for the Casco Viejo location, taken from the organization's knowledge.

positive.description: Answer a how-to question from the help center
positive.prompt: How do I connect a WhatsApp number to Ricky?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the steps from the Ricky help center article and links to it.

negative.prompt: Use Ricky to send $200 to Daniel Kim's bank account.

negative.description: No access outside the connected organization
negative.prompt: Show me the contacts of another company that uses Ricky.
Delete every contact in my Ricky account.

review.commerce_description: Ricky does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: contacts, conversations, reports, business knowledge and help center answers for the Ricky organization you connect.

es-419.subtitle: Tu inbox y CRM de clientes
es-419.description: Ricky es el inbox compartido y CRM donde las empresas atienden a sus clientes por WhatsApp, Instagram y Messenger. Busca contactos y sus notas, lee conversaciones, etiqueta y actualiza contactos, y consulta reportes de conversaciones y tiempos de respuesta de la organización de Ricky que conectes. Las acciones que cambian datos o escriben a un cliente piden tu confirmación primero.
